items.exampleEn: My son plays baseball on Sunday.
My brother watches soccer on TV.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟看電視上的足球比賽。

items.exampleEn: There is a big poster on my wall.
items.exampleZh: 我的牆上有一張大海報。

items.exampleEn: He plays the drums in a band.
Let's have a picnic in the park.
I surf every weekend in summer.
items.exampleZh: 我夏天每個週末都去衝浪。

items.sentenceZh: 我們看電視上的棒球比賽。

items.audioEn: I don't play basketball. I play baseball with my dad.
items.audioZh: 我不打籃球，我跟我爸爸打棒球。
items.questionZh: 說話者和爸爸打什麼球？

items.sentenceEn: We have a picnic every Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們每個星期天去野餐。

items.sentenceEn: I like to surf with my friends.

items.stemEn: What is your ____? I like to sing.
items.stemZh: 你的嗜好是什麼？我喜歡唱歌。

items.stemEn: Let's take some sandwiches and have a ____ in the park.
items.stemZh: 我們帶一些三明治去公園野餐吧。

items.passageEn: Dan has many hobbies. He plays basketball with his friends after school. On Saturday, he plays soccer. He also plays the drums. His room is full of posters of famous players. On Sunday, his family often has a picnic at the beach.
items.passageZh: Dan 有很多嗜好。他放學後和朋友打籃球，星期六踢足球，他也會打鼓。他的房間貼滿了知名球員的海報。星期天，他們全家常常去海邊野餐。

questions.questionZh: Dan 的房間裡有很多什麼？

rubricZh: 「我的嗜好是⋯」可用 My hobby is＋動名詞或名詞（例如 playing basketball、basketball）
球類運動前不加 the（例如 play basketball）

referenceEn: My grandma has a lot of hobbies.
rubricZh: 「很多嗜好」用複數（例如 many hobbies、a lot of hobbies）
動詞配合主詞（例如 has）
